description: Human decisions about the audio library, keyed by asset id: what each file actually is, what it is called, and which moments inside it a cue can fire on. The pipeline READS this and never writes it, so re-running the pipeline can never overwrite a decision. An asset with no entry here is unreviewed: still playable and auditionable, just flagged. Nothing has been reviewed yet — the classifier's proposals stand until someone listens.

eva-3-15.note: Corrupted source: a brief full-scale digital static burst at ~1:59 (measured source true peak +5.0 dBTP, vs. this batch's normal ceiling of about +0.6 dBTP). Reported by ear by Ingram 2026-09-27. Not repairable; source stays in audio/in-tray/music/mystery/ untouched, but excluded from every pool and will never be (re)processed.

eva-3-17.note: Corrupted source: a brief full-scale digital static burst at ~1:33 (measured source true peak +4.1 dBTP). Reported by ear by Ingram 2026-09-27, who deleted the in-tray original — audio/library/music/eva-3-17.ogg was the last surviving copy and has now been deleted too, so no copy of this track remains anywhere in the project. Not repairable.
